values.description: APISIX proxy (host). Not 9080 — gvproxy holds that on this host.

IN-NETWORK issuer. APISIX validates issuer keycloak:8888, so the token must be minted in-network. run-tests.sh does this and injects access_token; the Auth folder works only if newman itself runs on opa-abac-example_default. See docs/guides/E2E-TESTING.md.
Injected by run-tests.sh (--env-var access_token=...). Leave blank in the file.

The chained ids (catalog_id/category_id/product_id) are deliberately NOT declared as environment vars. Each folder captures them into COLLECTION variables at runtime; an (empty) env var of the same name would shadow the collection value during {{...}} substitution (env scope wins over collection scope) and every downstream URL would render with an empty id. Disabled placeholder, documents the choice.
